يغتال (form VIII)
# يَغْتَالُ (yaḡtālu) /jaɣ.taː.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# يُغْتَالُ (yuḡtālu) /juɣ.taː.lu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# يَغْتَالَ (yaḡtāla) /jaɣ.taː.la/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِغْتَالَ (iḡtāla)
# يُغْتَالَ (yuḡtāla) /juɣ.ta
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
